book.name: GALESIA
book.title: Pol nainge tup nal me lenge Galesia

content: Got si nalaŋatme Pol ŋaiye ka ende wah aposel

Ŋam Pol, ŋam aposel ende. Ŋupe ŋaiye ŋam mambaꞌe wah taꞌe aposel pe, yukur mitiŋ syeꞌ topoꞌe miyeꞌ kekep yalaŋatme ŋam, pakai. Kom Jisas Krais hindi Yai Got, ŋaiye ŋahraꞌe Krais nasme ŋeheh tahar narp pe, tinge yalaŋatme ŋam.
Ŋam topoꞌe lenge Kristen toꞌ tatai lalme ŋaiye yotop ŋam yarp eꞌe member ŋau bwore mal lenge sios Galesia.
Yai Got poi topoꞌe Lahmborenge Jisas Krais ka yul yip ŋoihmbwaip ŋumwaiye topoꞌe ŋoihmbwaip michukor.
Jisas Krais nulme pupwa poi gande ŋasande tikin Yai Got poi pe, kin nungwisme poi ŋaiye ya musme pupwa tikin kekep eꞌe.
Taꞌe luku pe, ya mirisukwarme Yai Got nye nyermbe. Mise.
Wusyep bwore mise ŋilyeh tukwini ki sai
Ŋam gunguru plai ŋaiye nilyehe sai yip si yasme Got, miyeꞌ ŋaiye kin si nambaꞌ yip nato ŋoihginir tikin Jisas Krais. Pe yip yal jande wusyep ŋoinde tikin.

Yip ŋoiheryembe nange luku ki wusyep bwore mise, kom pakai. Liki yukur wusyep bwore mise. Kom yip jande lenge miyeꞌ homboꞌe ŋaiye bunjenge wusyep bwore mise tikin Krais pe, ŋoiheryembe yip si nalꞌe nalꞌe.
Kom ŋaiye poi aposel, lakai walip hlaꞌ ende ka ininge alaŋatme wusyep bwore mise ŋaiye ki ŋoinde tikin me wusyep, ŋaiye poi somohon mana yip pe, kin ka el nih ŋaiye susyuꞌ nye nyermbe.

Wusyep eꞌe somohon poi manange, kom tukwini ŋam plihe manange. Ŋaiye miyeꞌ ende ka ininge alaŋatme wusyep bwore mise ŋaiye ki ŋoinde tikin me wusyep, ŋaiye yip si yasande pe, Got ka ende wachaihme kin.

Leꞌe yukur ŋam manange ŋaiye lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ka pule naŋ ŋembere, pakai. Got ka ambaꞌe naŋ ŋembere. Ŋaiye ŋam masande nange lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ka pule naŋ ŋembere pe, ŋam yukur miyeꞌ wah tikin Krais.
Pol nambaꞌe wah aposel taꞌe lai
Ŋam da mini yip toꞌ tatai ŋam na, wusyep bwore mise eꞌe ŋaiye ŋam manange malaŋatme malme yip pe, yukur ki gande ŋoihmbwaip tikin miyeꞌ kekep eꞌe.
Topoꞌe yukur ŋam mambaꞌe matme miyeꞌ ende, lakai miyeꞌ ende pwale sande tekeꞌe, pakai. Jisas Krais kitikin ki pasam wusyep uku.
Yip si yisande ŋaimune ŋaiye somohon ŋam mende, ŋupe ŋaiye ŋam gwande lotu lenge Juta pe, ŋam yukur ŋoihginirme lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge tikin Got. Ŋam mende yumbune lenge pupwa supule.
Ŋup uku pe, ŋam gwande ŋoihmbwaip yerkeime lenge mwan kaꞌ poi bongol sekete ŋaiye yende lotu pe, wachaih ŋaiye ŋam mende luku pe, ki yohme lenge lahyambe wula wula Juta.
Kom ŋoihmbwaip bwore bwore tikin Got, kin nalaŋatme ŋam somohonme ŋaiye mam waraꞌe ŋam nange ma gunde kin.
Topoꞌe ŋupe ŋaiye kin ŋoiheryembe pe, kin pasam ŋam Talah kin, ŋaiye ma mininge wusyep bwore mise kin mil lenge haiten miyeꞌ tuweinge. Ŋam yukur mambaꞌe sande tekeꞌe matme miyeꞌ ende.
O ŋam yukur mal Jerusalem ma metekeꞌe lenge miyeꞌ ŋaiye si tahar jan taꞌe aposel, ŋaiye yal yerme ŋam, pakai. Ŋendehei ŋam mal Arebia miꞌe pe, ŋam plihe mat moi Damaskus.
Wahtaip hun si nal miꞌe pe, ŋam mal Jerusalem mala mininge wusyep topoꞌme Pita pe, poi hindi marp Sande hoi.
O ŋam yukur metekeꞌe aposel ŋoinde, pakai. Miyeꞌ esep ilyeh ŋaiye ŋam metekeꞌe pe, Jems, toꞌ tikin Lahmborenge Jisas.
Wusyep mune ŋaiye ŋam mainge pe, luku ki bwore mise. Got ki sisyeme nange yukur ŋam homboꞌe.
Miꞌe pe, ŋam malꞌe malꞌe ma moto moi ŋaiye sai nato provins Siria topoꞌe provins Silisia.
Ŋup uku pe, lenge Kristen miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye yarp yato provins Judia yukur sisyeme ŋam.

Tinge sisyeme sai wusyep ŋaiye mitiŋ yana lenge na, “Miyeꞌ iki, somohon kin ŋende yumbune lenge Kristen miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip tinge teŋeime Krais. Kom tukwini kin ŋanange nalaŋatme wusyep mise ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip poi teŋeime.”
Tinge yahraꞌe naŋ Got me ŋaimune ŋaiye ŋende me ŋam.
